task: LivenessNet training run on NUAA with four subject folds and three training seeds (subject-held-out, session-matched check), authorised by the coordinator on 3 November 2026 on the C2 card after the approval of the fold schema (PR #16, run 20261103-FOLDS-67b7f3d): 4 folds per subject, seeds 42/43/44, overall compute cap 6 hours, the delivered configuration unchanged; input and cache checks first; preprocessing, split and recipe fixed; threshold on the dev only, frozen before the test; every outcome kept and delivered (code, configuration, scores, tables, logs, SHA-256).
authorisation: coordinator, C2 card, comment of 3 November 2026 (evening): 'Il protocollo va bene. Può procedere con l'implementazione e l'esecuzione dell'esperimento LivenessNet su CPU: 4 fold per soggetto, seed 42/43/44 e limite di calcolo complessivo di 6 ore, secondo la configurazione consegnata. Esegua prima i controlli previsti sugli input e sulla cache. Se passano, proceda senza attendere un altro via libera.'

manifests.origin: M2 package 20261006-M2-seed42-36c677a (accepted); the manifests are restricted; their SHA-256 and counts are those recorded in the accepted N1 and N2 configurations

cache.order: X_train = spread per class of the official training list (bona fide first) = cnn_train + cnn_es; X_test = spread of the official test list = cnn_test (M2 rule, verified by the N2 cache check and again here)
cache.built: 2026-09-12 with the extractor face.py 0ac7143, reproduced bit for bit from the originals in N2 and again by the cache-check step of this run; the detectors counted per frame must equal those of the N2 cache check (results/n2/20261029-N2-sessions-2ac3e29/cache_check.json)

extraction.chain: train_cnn.preprocess (unchanged): cv2.imread, frozen detector (RetinaFace, Haar fallback), Face.crop(margin=0.15, square=True) or the whole image when no face, cv2.resize 256x256 INTER_AREA, BGR to RGB, advanced_image_enhancement of the reference create_datasets.py, uint8; the detector used is recorded for every frame (restricted)

architecture.name: LivenessNet
architecture.chosen: by the coordinator on 3 November 2026, to stay comparable with N1 (create_model('LivenessNet').get_model() of the reference code, unchanged)

training.checkpoint: weights of the epoch with minimum val_loss on the dev frames (EarlyStopping restore_best_weights; set_weights when the epochs end first)
training.loss: CategoricalCrossentropy, one-hot labels (index 0 bona fide, 1 attack)
training.class_weight: balanced on the fitting set: n / (2 * n_class)
training.augmentation: RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomRotation(0.03), RandomZoom(0.12, 0.12), RandomTranslation(0.06, 0.06), RandomBrightness(0.15, value_range=(0, 1)), RandomContrast(0.2), GaussianNoise(0.02); fitting set only
training.seeds: train_seed for random, numpy and TensorFlow (weight initialisation, augmentation, batch order); no split seed: the folds and the samples are deterministic

threshold.criterion: eer, the M1 protocol: candidates = distinct dev scores plus nextafter(min, -inf) if >= 0; attack if score > value (tie = bona fide); minimum of |fp * n_attack - fn * n_bona_fide| on integers, ties to the highest value
threshold.frozen_before_test: written to fold<k>_seed<s>_threshold.json from the dev scores, read back, SHA-256 recorded in every test score row; the test frames are scored only afterwards (card: test_scored_after_threshold)
threshold.also_reported: the fixed threshold 0.5 of C1, N1 and N2, labelled 05
threshold.dev_reuse_declared: the dev frames drive early stopping, learning-rate reduction, the restored epoch and the threshold (as in N1 and in the C2 protocol); the dev does not identify a unique threshold when its classes separate completely and gives no guarantee of transfer

metrics.decision: attack if score_attack > threshold (tie = bona fide)
metrics.per_unit: per fold, seed and session stratum of the held-out subjects (01, 02, 03 and all), NA where a class is absent: n_bona_fide, n_attack, accepted attacks, rejected bona fide, APCER, BPCER, ACER at 0.5 and at the dev threshold, AUROC (threshold-free)
metrics.per_subject: the same per held-out subject and stratum (restricted per_subject.csv)
metrics.auroc: Mann-Whitney U with ties counted 0.5 (equal to roc_auc_score), score_attack as the separator, attack positive
metrics.aggregation: values of every fold and seed; median and range over seeds per fold; pooled counts over the four folds per session and seed (every subject held out exactly once); median and range over seeds of the pooled values; no fold or seed selection
metrics.uncertainty: bootstrap over subjects: 1,000 resamples with replacement of the held-out subjects of the stratum (pooled over the four folds, per seed), percentiles 2.5-97.5 of the pooled ACER (at the dev threshold and at 0.5) and AUROC; random seed 0; no interval for a stratum with fewer than 5 subjects; no statistical test. Declared: the pooled estimate is a cross-validation aggregate scored by four models with four dev thresholds; the session strata hold at most 9 subjects (sessions 01-02: 9; session 03 bona fide: 9), so the interval is coarse
metrics.pre_commitment: reported whatever the outcome; no change of recipe, threshold criterion, folds or counts after any score is read

budget.estimate: about 8-11 min per training on the CPU for 2,507 fitting frames in N1 (wall 496-671 s); 2,100 fitting frames here, so at most about 2.5 h of training; the cache check of 6,000 frames and the extraction of 6,614 with the frozen extractor before the trainings; 12 scoring passes; the estimate holds on an idle machine (under load the reviewer measured 1.5 s per step against 0.4 in N1): the run is launched with the machine otherwise idle
budget.on_cap_exceeded: stop, no results; report as a failed run (checked at every step boundary, before the final writes and at the end of every epoch; elapsed time = the larger of the monotonic and the wall clock)

declarations.cpu_nondeterminism: the seeds fix the initialisation, the augmentation and the batch order; on the CPU parallel reductions may still give minimal differences between two runs with the same seed (N1, n1_trainer.py); enable_op_determinism is not used
declarations.diagnostic: diagnostic protocol, not a benchmark and not a complete causal isolation: adding session 03 to training also adds variety, so a low error on the held-out subjects would be consistent with an N1/C1 failure due to 'session not represented, or training data too narrow' rather than to the session alone; a high error would be consistent with a failure of the recipe; both readings are diagnostic, not causal
declarations.exploratory: the NUAA session-03 results are already known (C1, M1, N1, N2): the schema is a rule fixed before any training, not a confirmatory test
declarations.limits: frames of one subject and session stay correlated; per-subject counts are unbalanced (session 03 bona fide for 9 of 16 subjects, 3 of them training subjects); sessions 01-02 exist for 9 subjects only, so the session 01-02 test and dev strata rest on 2-3 subjects per fold and a single session x class cell there can rest on one subject (two training subjects lack bona fide frames in one of the two sessions); the fixed fitting counts under-sample session 03 (about 18-25% of its bona fide and 11-13% of its attacks are used) and use most of sessions 01-02; the dev of a held-out fold is the test fold of the next one, so the four fold results are not independent (different models, no leakage); three seeds give a range, not a confidence interval; one dataset, one attack type (print)
declarations.question: When the capture session is represented in training, does the N1 recipe generalise to subjects it has never seen? N2 already measured the opposite cell (the 9 training subjects in session 03: BPCER 0.6873 for every seed, AUROC 0.3171-0.4569); this schema measures new subjects with every session represented in training.

outputs.public: aggregate.json, aggregate.md, run_record.json, SHA256SUMS: rules, counts, metrics per fold, seed and stratum, summaries, bootstrap intervals, training cards (epochs, restored epoch, val_loss, seconds, dev thresholds), timings, environment, SHA-256 of the inputs; no subject identifier, no image key
outputs.restricted: per model: card.json, threshold.json, dev_scores.csv, test_scores.csv, LivenessNet.keras; per_subject.csv, extracted_frames.csv (detector and frame SHA-256 per extracted frame), public_SHA256SUMS.sha256 (anchor of the public folder), SHA256SUMS
